prompt: Create a simple flat vector illustration, clean minimal design, soft rounded shapes of dog stool for a pet health app. Use muted natural tones, soft shadows, no harsh colors. Background: plain solid very light beige (#FAF8F5) background, no patterns, no gradients. Rendering: flat colors with subtle soft shadow underneath for grounding, slight highlight on top. View: top-down 3/4 view looking at ground level. Shape: two or three smooth log-shaped pieces, well-formed, holding shape perfectly. Color: healthy medium brown. Key identifying feature: clean defined edges, holds together well, looks firm and solid. Surface/texture: smooth with a subtle healthy sheen. Do NOT include: any text or labels, badges or icons, realistic/photorealistic style, gross details like flies or smell lines, complex backgrounds, human hands or tools, dogs or other animals. Keep it clean, simple, and educational - not gross or realistic. This image helps pet owners identify what "normal" stool looks like.
